messages.subject: calculating  ω
parts:
Hi Cris,

I can calculate small-world σ, however I got following errors when generating random graphs with clustering controlling .

datadir <- paste0('C:/sm')
exclude.subs <- NULL
use.mean <- FALSE 

init.vars <- brainGraph_init(atlas='destrieux', densities=seq(0.05, 0.07, 0.01),
datadir=datadir, modality='thickness',
exclude.subs=exclude.subs, use.mean=use.mean)

lapply(seq_along(init.vars), function(x)
assign(names(init.vars)[x], eval(init.vars[[x]]), envir=.GlobalEnv))
N <- which(abs(densities - 0.06) < 0.001)
all.dat.resids <- get.resid(all.dat.tidy, covars, exclude='Group')
resids.all <- all.dat.resids$resids.all
formulas <- all.dat.resids$formulas
resids.all <- all.dat.resids$resids.all

corrs <- lapply(groups, function(x)
lapply(densities, function(y)
corr.matrix(resids.all[x], density=y)))
g <- lapply(corrs, lapply, function(x)
graph_from_adjacency_matrix(x$r.thresh, mode='undirected', diag=F))
g <- Map(function(x, y) llply(x, set.brainGraph.attributes, atlas=atlas,
modality=modality, group=y, .progress='text'),
g, as.list(groups))
kNumRand <- 5e1
clustering <- F
outdir <- paste0('C:/sm/rnd')

rand_vars <- analysis_random_graphs(g, kNumRand, covars, savedir=outdir,
clustering=clustering)

phi.norm <- rand_vars$rich
small.dt <- rand_vars$small
rand.dt <- rand_vars$rand

kNumRandClust <- 1e2
g.rand <- vector('list', length=length(groups))

for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
g.rand[[i]] <- vector('list', length=kNumDensities)
for (j in seq_along(densities)) {
g.rand[[i]][[j]] <- sim.rand.graph.par(g[[i]][[j]],
kNumRandclust, clustering=T)
}
small.clust.dt[[i]] <- small.world(g[[i]], lapply(g.rand[[i]], with, g))
}
>>Error in graph_attr(y, "Lp") : Not a graph object


g[[1]][[2]]$Lp
>[1] 2.74197


am I missing something? 
Onur

messages.author: 28bb28f8fe8898a5
messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] calculating ω
parts:
No, you are not missing anything. I apologize but my code in the User Guide is wrong; I will update it shortly. It looks like you are using v0.72.0 of the package, in which I updated the output of "sim.rand.graph.par" when "clustering=T".

In the meantime, you have to change the line calling "small.world":

small.clust.dt[[i]] <- small.world(g[[i]], g.rand[[i]])

This should work, but note that the random graph generation will take quite a long time, particularly if you are using the Destrieux atlas. But the graph densities are low, so it may not be exceedingly long. Please let me know if it works.

Chris

messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] calculating ω
parts: Thank you Cris, now I can calculate omega with following procedure;

small.clust.dt <- vector('list', length=2)
small.clust.dt[[i]] <- vector('list', length=length(densities))

kNumRandClust <- 1e2 
g.rand <- vector('list', length=length(groups))

for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
g.rand[[i]] <- vector('list', length=kNumDensities)
for (j in seq_along(densities)) {
g.rand[[i]][[j]] <- sim.rand.graph.par(g[[i]][[j]],

kNumRandClust, clustering=T)
}
small.clust.dt[[i]] <- small.world(g[[i]], g.rand[[i]])
}
gsmall.clust.dt <- rbindlist(small.clust.dt)
gsmall.clust.dt[, Group := rep(groups, each=kNumDensities)]
setkey(gsmall.clust.dt, Group, density)

omega <- small.dt[, Lp.rand / Lp] - gsmall.clust.dt[, Cp / Cp.rand]
___

Thanks for your time,
Onur.
